errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the chart compares daily new cases with the number of news media reports, which is the main purpose indicated by the title 'Trend of daily new patient numbers and news media report numbers'.
The chart's x-axis displays data from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, not from July 15 to September 26.
The chart legend indicates the bars represent 'Global confirmed cases on that day' (该日全球确诊数量), not data from different countries.

errors.text_span: 标签为“每日全体人数与新增病例数目”
errors.evidence: The left y-axis label is 'Daily new patient numbers' (每日新增患者人数). The label provided in the description is incorrect and seems to be a confused mix of the title and axis label.
The description completely omits the presence of the right y-axis, which represents the 'Daily number of news media reports' (新闻媒体每日报道数目).
The tick interval for the left y-axis (number of patients) is 200,000, not 100,000.

errors.text_span: 图中的柱状图代表不同的国家，颜色依次为浅绿色、浅蓝色、浅黄色和深蓝色。
errors.evidence: The bars are all a single color (teal/blue-green) and represent global daily totals, not different countries with distinct colors.
The description fails to mention the blue line graph, which is a major component of the chart representing the number of COVID-19 news reports.

errors.text_span: 最长柱状图，对应于2022年8月22日，高度为约 1600000。
errors.evidence: The highest bar (peak cases) occurs around mid-July (approx. July 15-16), reaching about 1,600,000. The bar for August 22 is much shorter, around 900,000.

errors.text_span: 最短柱状图，对应于2022年8月5日，高度为约 200000。
errors.evidence: The bar on August 5 is not the shortest; its value is around 800,000. The shortest bars are approximately 400,000 (e.g., around July 4 or July 11), and no bar is as low as 200,000.
